d: Former Indian cricket captain Virat Kohli has built his legacy on consistency in ODI cricket. But now his strike rate has climbed, his six-hitting frequency has changed dramatically. After another stunning innings against New Zealand in the first IND vs NZ ODI, questions are emerging about how much Kohli has transformed his game. Rupha Ramani dissects the statistics behind India's batting superstar, comparing different phases of his ODI career, his post-retirement performances in international cricket and his current form.
